context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: 文体/電動/見送り/例文/厚み/大きめ/学費/利上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、ビジネス文体、教科書通りでは、堅すぎる。
lines.en: Ren — your business writing is too textbook. It needs flexibility.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Speaking from experience. Measured pace. Slight pause before the redirect, as if showing him the problem and then the path forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。電動アシスト自転車、通勤、楽です。
lines.style: Quiet and eager to learn. Slight nervous energy under the surface. Keeps it brief — not wanting to waste his mentor's time with extra words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 判断、見送りも、戦略のうちだ。
lines.en: Knowing when to hold back on a decision — that's strategy too.
lines.style: Steady conviction. Light emphasis on the logic, not lecturing. Warm underneath — reassuring him that hesitation isn't weakness.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。営業の例文、覚えていきます。
lines.en: I understand. I'll study more sales examples.
lines.style: Respectful nod in his voice. Formal but genuine. Shows he's taking this in, not just performing compliance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プレゼン資料、厚みが出る形で。
lines.en: Your presentation materials need more substance to them.
lines.style: Clear instruction. No softening. The tone of someone who expects follow-through because he sees the capacity in you.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: スーツ、大きめサイズが、後輩、楽みたいです。
lines.en: I've heard larger-sized suits make things easier for the newer staff.
lines.style: Tentative observation offered up. Slightly uncertain — testing whether this practical detail matters. Genuine curiosity underneath the awkwardness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 就活、学費支援制度、各社で違うから、調べろ。
lines.en: Job hunting — tuition support programs differ by company, so research them yourself.
lines.style: Directive and efficient. No preamble. The tone of someone giving him real tools, not hand-holding.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。利上げ動向、業界に与える影響、学びます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll study how interest rate changes affect the industry.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Quieter than before — he's absorbed what was said. Settled and forward-focused. Slight exhale of commitment.
